title: spec(permissionForm): the `name` help says it is derived from the label, but a Chinese or Japanese label derives an empty name and nothing prompts
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V

Filing gate: ② a should-fix a contract review carried out of scope (triage contract review 6526229582 on PR #28152, card #27864, attempt 2). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 · `marchtian` · session `session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade and no lane: triage sets both (the copy is `packages/spec`, the prompt is `ui/packages/app-shell`).
Reader: the lane triage assigns.
Dedupe (open AND closed): semantic search "slugify CJK label derives empty name no prompt create form non-Latin" → 9 hits, all about translated labels and option text (#26452, #26608, #10287, …). None is the label-to-name derivation for non-Latin labels. **New.**
reach: **read in code, NOT measured through a public door.** Console › Setup › Permission sets › New in a zh-CN or ja-JP session, after PR #28152: type a Chinese or Japanese Label.

## What the code says

- `slugify` keeps only `[a-z0-9]`, so a CJK label derives to the empty string. `useCreateDerive` then clears `name` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/createDerive.ts`: "Empty derivations … just clear the target; the UI then knows to prompt for manual entry"), but no Console surface issues that prompt.
- PR #28152's `permissionForm` `name` help reads "Derived from the label when you create the set; snake_case", and the zh-CN / ja-JP bundles say the name is generated from the display name. Those are exactly the locales where the derivation never fires, so the user sees an empty, starred Name under a hint that says it was filled.

## Wanted

- Source help for the `name` row says what happens in both cases, e.g. "Filled from the label when it can be spelled in snake_case; otherwise type it (snake_case)", with the three hand translations following.
- Optionally, when the derivation comes back empty, the create form says so next to Name (the prompt `createDerive.ts` assumes exists).

Related: #27864 / PR #28152 (contract review should-fix 2).
